[SWS_ANM_00022]
⌈
When the network is requested (by setting the value
of NetworkRequestedState to true) and the current state is the Ready Sleep State,
the Ready Sleep State shall be left and the Normal Operation State shall be entered.
⌋

[SWS_ANM_00022]
⌈

workRequestedState to kFullCom) and the current state is the Ready Sleep State,
the Ready Sleep State shall be left and the Normal Operation State shall be entered.
⌋
